AI Companies Compete with Advanced Coding Agents

DeepSeek has released a prototype of an enhanced coding agent designed to compete with Anthropic's Claude Code. Anthropic, which filed to go public on the US stock market on October 26, has acknowledged the potential dangers of AI in a 92-page risk factor document. The CEO of Anthropic had previously expressed concerns about AI becoming "too autonomous."
